originalTitle: Reliance Retail Q1 revenue rises, but profit falls as e-commerce weighs
simplifiedContent: Reliance Retail, a big company, had an 8.2% increase in sales in the first quarter of the year. However, its profit decreased by 14.2% because it spent a lot on its online shopping business, which affected its overall profitability. The company's consumer business did well, with sales more than doubling, thanks to strong performances from its Campa and Independence brands. This means that while the company is selling more, its costs are increasing, which is affecting its bottom line. The decrease in profit is something to note, as it may impact investor interest in the company.

originalTitle: JSW Steel’s profit doubles on revenue growth, beats estimates
simplifiedContent: JSW Steel, a steel company, made a lot of money in the last quarter - its profit was more than double what it was last year, at Rs 4,696 crore. This happened because the company made more money from selling its products and didn't have to pay as much in interest on loans. The company's total sales rose by about 10% compared to last year, and its expenses didn't increase as much, which helped its profits. This is a good sign for the company, and it's doing better than people expected. The company is still planning to spend the same amount of money on new projects and investments as it originally planned.

originalTitle: Netflix shares tumble over 10% as slowing growth, less viewership data spook investors
simplifiedContent: Netflix's stock price dropped by more than 10% because the company said it will grow more slowly than expected. This made investors worried about the company's future. Netflix also announced that it will stop sharing as much information about how many people are watching its shows, which added to the worry. Analysts think the company's lineup of new content this year wasn't strong enough, which contributed to the drop in stock price. This is a big deal because it means the value of Netflix's stock has fallen significantly from its highest point.

originalTitle: Netflix shares tumble 13% after weak sales forecast, hit 22-month low
simplifiedContent: Netflix's stock price dropped by 12.6% to its lowest point in 22 months. This happened because the company said it doesn't expect to make as much money as people thought it would, even though its recent financial results were okay. The company is having some trouble with its original content and its stock price has been going down since mid-2025. As a result, the company has lowered its expectations for how well it will do in 2026. This matters because it shows that Netflix is facing some challenges and investors are losing confidence in the company.

originalTitle: Sebi clears automatic SWP, STP mandates for demat mutual fund holdings
simplifiedContent: The Indian stock market regulator, Sebi, has made a new rule that allows investors to set up automatic instructions for their demat mutual fund holdings. This means that investors can now automatically transfer or withdraw money from their mutual funds held in a demat account. Previously, this option was only available for mutual funds held in a different form, called a statement of account. This change is important because it makes it easier for investors to manage their mutual fund investments. Sebi's new rule applies to two specific types of automatic instructions, called Systematic Withdrawal Plan (SWP) and Systematic Transfer Plan (STP).

originalTitle: Pulse of the Street: Earnings sentiment rescues volatile week; real test ahead
simplifiedContent: Here's what you need to know: the Indian stock market had a good week, with the Sensex (a group of 30 important stocks) going up by 0.75% and the Nifty 50 (a broader group of 50 stocks) going up by 0.53%. Most of these gains happened on Friday, when the Nifty jumped 1.1% and the Sensex went up by 1.25%. This means that the value of these stocks increased, which is good news for investors. The Sensex also reached its highest closing level since June 12, 2026, which is a significant milestone. This uptrend is a positive sign for the market, but it's not clear if it will continue.
